title: 13# Musa & Bani Israel 1
arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ إن الحمد لله، نحمده ونستعينه ونستغفره ونستهديه،

ونعوذ بالله من شرور أنفسنا ومن سيئات أعمالنا، من يهده الله فلا مضل له ومن يضلل فلا هادي له، وأشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وأشهد أن محمدرسول الله، امَّا بعد

ونحمدالله عزوجل الذى بنعمت اجتمع الصالحات وَإِذْ أَنجَيْنَاكُم مِّنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱجْعَل لَّنَآ إِلَٰهًا كَمَا لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌ ۚ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says;

وَجَٰوَزْنَا بِبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْبَحْرَ فَأَتَوْاْ عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ يَعْكُفُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَصْنَامٍۢ لَّهُمْ ۚ قَالُواْ يَٰمُوسَى ٱجْعَل لَّنَآ إِلَٰهًا كَمَا لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌ ۚ

الضعيف يتشبه بالقوي العِزَّةُ للَّهِ‏ِ ولِرَسولِهِ ولِلمُؤمِنينَ‏ ٱجْعَل لَّنَآ ءَالِهَةٌ ۚ ٱجْعَل لَّنَآ إِلَٰهًا كَمَا لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌ ۚ

أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ۝

قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ۝

إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ مُتَبَّرٌ مَا هُمْ فِيهِ وَبَاطِلٌ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ۝

قَالَ أَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ أَبْغِيكُمْ إِلَٰهًا وَهُوَ فَضَّلَكُمْ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ۝

كُنْتُمْ خَيْرَ أُمَّةٍ أُخْرِجَتْ لِلنَّاسِ وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱذْكُرُواْ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَعَلَ فِيكُمْ أَنۢبِيَآءَ وَجَعَلَكُم مُّلُوكًا وَءَاتَىٰكُم

وَءَاتَىٰكُم مَّا لَمْ يُؤْتِ أَحَدًا مِّنَ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ۝

يَا قَوْمِ ادْخُلُوا الْأَرْضَ الْمُقَدَّسَةَ الَّتِي كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا عَلَىٰ أَدْبَارِكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا عَلَىٰ أَدْبَارِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا خَاسِرِينَ۝

الفرار من الزحف الفرار من الزحف تحبط الاعمال وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا فَتَنقَلِبُوا خَاسِرِينَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; قَالُواْ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّ فِيهَا قَوْمًا جَبَّارِينَ وَإِنَّا لَن نَّدْخُلَهَا حَتَّىٰ يَخْرُجُواْ مِنْهَا وَإِنَّا لَن نَّدْخُلَهَا حَتَّىٰ يَخْرُجُواْ مِنْهَا فَإِن يَخْرُجُواْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّا دَٰخِلُونَ۝

فَيَخْرُجُواْ مِنْهَا، إِنَّا دَٰخِلُونَ۝

قَالَ رَجُلَانِ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمَا ٱدْخُلُواْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْبَابَ فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُمُوهُ فَإِنَّكُمْ غَٰلِبُونَ ۚ

يَخَافُونَ قَالَ رَجُلَانِ يَخَافُونَ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; أَتَخْشَوْنَهُمْ ۚ فَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَوْهُ قَالُواْ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَن نَّدْخُلَهَآ أَبَدًا مَّا دَامُواْ فِيهَا ۖ

فَٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَرَبُّكَ فَقَٰتِلَآ إِنَّا هَٰهُنَا قَٰعِدُونَ۝

اَلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ أشِيرُواعَلَيَّ أيُّها النَّاسُ قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ إِلَّا نَفْسِى وَأَخِى ۖ فَٱفْرُقْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْفَٰسِقِينَ۝

قَالَ فَإِنَّهَا مُحَرَّمَةٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ۛ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً ۛ يَتِيهُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ فَلَا تَأْسَ عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْفَٰسِقِينَ۝

وَوَاعَدْنَا مُوسَىٰ ثَلَاثِينَ لَيْلَةً أَتْمَمْنَاهَا بِعَشْرٍ وَأَتْمَمْنَاهَا بِعَشْرٍ فَتَمَّ مِيقَاتُ رَبِّهِ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً ۚ وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَخِيهِ هَارُونَ اخْلُفْنِي فِي قَوْمِي وَأَصْلِحْ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ۝

وَلَمَّا جَآءَ مُوسَىٰ لِمِيقَٰتِنَا وَكَلَّمَهُۥ رَبُّهُۥ رَبِّ أَرِنِىٓ أَنظُرْ إِلَيْكَ ۚ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told Musa(موسى); لَن تَرَىٰ نِى

فَسَاخل جَبَل فَخَرَّصَعِقًا Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; فَلَمَّا تَجَلَّىٰ رَبُّهُۥ لِلْجَبَلِ جَعَلَهُۥ دَكًّا وَخَرَّ مُوسَىٰ صَعِقًا ۚ فَلَمَّآ أَفَاقَ قَالَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ۝

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَظَلَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ الْغَمَامَ وَأَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَنَّ وَالسَّلْوَىىٰ ۖ كُلُوا مِن طَيِّبَاتِ مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ ۖ

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; But Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; يَتُوبُ عَلَى التَّائِبِين Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; إِذِ ٱسْتَسْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦ فَقُلْنَا ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْحَجَرَ ۖ فَٱنفَجَرَتْ مِنْهُ ٱثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ عَيْنًا ۖ

قَدْ عَلِمَ كُلُّ أُنَاسٍۢ مَّشْرَبَهُمْ ۖ كُلُواْ وَٱشْرَبُواْ مِن رِّزْقِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تَعْثَوْاْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ۝

وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَا مُوسَى۝

وَظَلَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ الْغَمَامَ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَإِذْ قُلْتُمْ يَا مُوسَىٰ لَن نَّصْبِرَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامٍ وَاحِدٍ فَادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُخْرِجْ لَنَا مِمَّا تُنبِتُ الْأَرْضُ مِن بَقْلِهَا

فَادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُخْرِجْ لَنَا مِمَّا تُنبِتُ الْأَرْضُ مِن بَقْلِهَا وَقِثَّائِهَا وَفُومِهَا وَعَدَسِهَا وَبَصَلِهَا ۖ اهْبِطُوا مِصْرًا فَإِنَّ لَكُمْ مَا سَأَلْتُمْ

لا تزال طائفة من أمتي ظاهرين على الحق،لا يضرهم من خالفهم حتى تقوم الساعة لتتبعن سنن من كان قبلكم، حذو القُذَّةِ بالقُذَّة، حتى لو دخلوا جُحْرَ ضَبٍّ لدخلتموه

فمن أيضا إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ كَانَتْ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ كِتَابًا مَّوْقُوتًا۝

يَٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍۢ ۖ قَالَ أَتَسْتَبْدِلُونَ الَّذِي هُوَ أَدْنَىٰ بِالَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ ۚ اهْبِطُوا مِصْرًا فَإِنَّ لَكُم مَّا سَأَلْتُمْ ۗ

اهْبِطُوا مِصْرًا اهْبِطُوا مِصْرًا فَإِنَّ لَكُم مَّا سَأَلْتُمْ ۗ Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; وَضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الذِّلَّةُ وَالْمَسْكَنَةُ

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى told Musa(موسى); وَمَآ أَعْجَلَكَ عَن قَوْمِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ۝

So, Allahسُبحانه وتعالى ask Musa(موسى); وَمَآ أَعْجَلَكَ عَن قَوْمِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ۝

قَالَ هُمْ أُوْلَآءِ عَلَىٰٓ أَثَرِى وَعَجِلْتُ إِلَيْكَ رَبِّ لِتَرْضَىٰ۝

وَخْلُفْنِى فِى قَوْمِى Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِن بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ السَّامِرِيُّ۝

قَالَ بَصُرْتُ بِمَا لَمْ يَبْصُرُوا بِهِ فَنَسِيَ هَٰذَا إِلَٰهُكُمْ وَإِلَٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِيَ۝

صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ
english:
We praise Allahسُبحانه وتعالى, whom without Him, no good could happened and all blessings are from Him.

We thank Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and we say; Alhamdulillah(اَلْحَمْدُ لله) and then; Alhamdulillah(اَلْحَمْدُ لله) and then; Alhamdulillah(اَلْحَمْدُ لله);

Who made it possible for us to worship Him.

If it wasn't for Him allowing us and assisting us to do so; we wouldn't have been able to make one Tasbeeha(تسبيهه) or one Tahlila(تحليله) or one Takbeera(تكبيره) or one Raka'ah(ركعه) or to fast one day.

It is all from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى and his Tawfeeq(توفيق) and assistance.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى saved Musa(موسى) and Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) from the strongest man and regime and army and nation, on the face of the earth.

To Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; there is nothing that is the superpower.

There is no one who is strong.

There is no government that is powerful.

For Allahسُبحانه وتعالى; they are all under Him and they are all His servants.

And for Allahسُبحانه وتعالى with Kun Fayakun(كُن فَيَكُون); everything is created or anything can be destroyed.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; We saved you from Firaun(فرعون) and his people.

Blessing from Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

Banu Israel(بنو اسرائيل) saw the miracle of Allah in front of their own eyes.

They saw the sea split into two portions which seemed like mountains.

And then they saw Firaun(فرعون) and his army drowning.

And they saw how Allahسُبحانه وتعالى delivered them to safety.

What was the first thing they did, when they reached to safety?

Banu Israel(بنو اسرائيل) the first thing they did, when they were with Musa(موسى), when they were traveling into a new land, finally they are in freedom now, released from the servitude of Firaun(فرعون)?

Banu Israel(بنو اسرائيل) saw some men worshipping some idols.

They went to Musa(موسى) and they said; They said; Oh Musa(موسى)! Can you create for us or make for us a god, like they have gods.

And we brought the children of Israel(اسرائيل) with safety across the sea, and they came upon people devoted to some of their idols in worship.

They said; Oh Moses! Make for us a God as they have Gods.

Subhanallahil-Azeem(سُبحَانَ اللهِ العَظِيم)! you just came out from Egypt.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى saved you and you saw the miracles of Allah with your own eyes.

You saw the miracles of Allah, assisting Musa(موسى) and assisting you and you were helpless and you couldn't do anything for yourselves.

And Allahسُبحانه وتعالى performs these miracles in front of your own eyes.

And then you ask Musa(موسى) to create for you a god, like they have Gods.

Banu Israel(بنو اسرائيل) they knew about Allah and they believed in Allah, Don't understand this wrong.

Don't think that Banu Israel(بنو اسرائيل) wanted to replace the religion with something else.

No!

They believed in Allah and they knew that Allah is the one who helped them and assisted them.

But when they saw what the other people are doing, they wanted to have something similar to them.

They are not satisfied with what they had.

They have an inferiority complex.

So they think that these gods are gonna bring them closer to Allahسُبحانه وتعالى or something.

Ibn Khaldoon(اِبن خَلدُون) says something interesting.

He says that, always weak nations imitate the strong nations.

The weak imitates the strong.

Banu Israel(بنو اسرائيل) were weak in Egypt, and they came out of Egypt, now they are in freedom, but they're still thinking with the weak mentality.

So they always think that the others have something better than them.

And you find among the Muslims who are weak today, those of them who are not proud with what Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has given them, they're always trying to find ways to imitate the others.

And who are they imitating?

They're imitating the West.

Because the West is strong.

So you find that the Muslim wants to look like the non-believers.

He wants to act like the non-believers.

He wants to celebrate like the non-believers.

He wants to do everything; the way the non-believers are acting.

One of the prominent priests of the Catholic Church in Italy.

So this priest wrote a letter to the Pope.

In that letter, he said; If you would just see the state of our Christian men; he was talking about Alfursaan(اَلفُرسَان); these are the Knights.

The Christian churches to send these Knights to raid the Muslim world, they would go to the Holy Land and these were very powerful small bands of horsemen.

And then they would dispatch them to the Muslim world to cause corruption.

And by the way, not only were they causing corruption on land, but it also happened in the sea.

Do you know who the pirates?

What are the pirates?

How were the pirates founded?

And do you know, who they were fighting?

Piracy; the whole issue of piracy and pirates in the sea, which we see a lot of cartoons and movies about.

It was started and invented to fight the Muslims in the Mediterranean Sea.

That is how piracy started.

Because the Mediterranean Sea was an Islamic sea for a very long time, with Al-Abbaseen(اَلعَبَّاسِين) and then Al-Usmaneen(اَلعُثمَانِين) was the power in the Mediterranean Sea.

So these pirates would go and they would raid the Muslim merchant; who are travelling in the Mediterranean Sea, anyway.

So this priest wrote a letter to the Pope.

He said; If you would see how our men try to dress like the Muslims and they learn Arabic and they write poetry of romance and love in Arabic better, than the Arabs.

Because the Muslims in that time were strong.

So you find that the weak is always trying to imitate the strong.

And now, things reversed.

So you have know, the Muslim is trying to imitate the ones who are strong.

But the Muslim should always believe that the strength is from Allah.

And the honor belongs to Allah.

Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; All honor belongs to Allah and His messenger and to the believers.

What we are going through now is a temporary state; it is not permanent.

So Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) are still thinking with that inferior; weak mentality.

So, they said; This action in itself; is it a sin or is it Kuffr(كفر)?

It is Kuffr(كفر).

It is disbelief.

When you're asking for a god, besides Allah that is Kuffr(كفر).

But what did Musa(موسى) tell them?

Did he say you are non believers, you are Kuffar(كفار)?

No, he didn't.

He said; You are people who are ignorant.

So he excuse them with their ignorance, but he taught them, and whoever refuses after they received the message, then that is disbelief.

So Musa(موسى) now is teaching them; he said; You are people who are ignorant.

And then he told them; Verily, these people will be destroyed; for that which they engaged in, and all that they're doing is in vain.

These people don't think that they're strong; don't think that they're powerful; they are going to be destroyed, what they're doing is; wrong.

He said; Shall I seek for you a god other than Allah while, He Has given you superiority over mankind?

Musa(موسى) is telling Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) that, Allah has chosen you.

They were the chosen people of Allah.

They were the nation whom Allah chose.

Even though up to that moment, they were still weak, and they didn't have any Khilafah(خِلَافَه), and they didn't have any nation, and they didn't have any power.

Nevertheless, they were still the best.

And the Muslims need to read the Ayah(آية) of Qur'an, where Allahسُبحانه وتعالى says; You were the best nation produced for mankind.

You are the best nation that was brought forth for humanity.

So even if we are in a slump in a weak moment, we should still understand and realize that we have; what can make us the best and the chosen people of Allahسُبحانه وتعالى.

So Musa(موسى) is telling Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) that; Allahسُبحانه وتعالى has given you superiority over mankind.

He has chosen you.

Musa(موسى) and Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) left Egypt, and they were promised the Holy Land, Jerusalem and the land surrounding it.

So Musa(موسى) and Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل) are traveled toward that direction.

They arrived next to Jerusalem.

Musa(موسى) told his people; Let's attack!

Here's Jerusalem, we can see it with our own eyes; Let's attack!

In that time, it was ruled by Al-Amaleeq(اَلْعَمَالِيْق); certain disbelieving nation.

They were the rulers of the Holy Land.

And Musa(موسى) told Bani Israel(بني أسرائيل); Allah has promised you with this land; so let's attack!

Oh my people! enter the Holy Land which Allah has assigned to you.

Do not turn back in fighting.

Turning your back in the battle; is one of the major sins in Islam.

Rasool Allah ﷺ has counted in one Hadith(حديث); seven major sins.

One of them is; Turning your back to the battlefield and running away.
